requirements.summary: 4 GB RAM · 40 GB disk · 4 GB USB
requirements.note: The download page recommends 40 GB of disk space and 4 GB of RAM for most Fedora variants, and says a 4 GB USB stick is enough for the live image.

page.description: Fedora editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: Fedora moves fast and ships upstream: GNOME, KDE Plasma and an atomic desktop, all on a six-month release train. Pick an edition, then the architecture of the machine that will run it.
pros: Workstation (GNOME) and KDE Plasma editions for both x86_64 and aarch64.
Silverblue ships the same GNOME desktop as an atomic image that updates in place.
Two releases are supported at a time, with a new one every six months.
Each CHECKSUM file is clearsigned, so the digest itself can be checked against Fedora's release key.
cons: A release lasts about 13 months: skip two and you upgrade or reinstall.
The download page asks for 40 GB of disk and 4 GB of RAM for most variants.
Silverblue and the other atomic images install and update as images, not package by package like Workstation.
Fedora 45 is already in beta, so this page's release ages quickly.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of Fedora 44 Workstation with GNOME, from Wikimedia Commons. Not a ROMinit recording: no image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.caption: Stock screenshot of Fedora 44 Workstation · no USB written, no boot tested.

page.status: One official path per edition: the live, atomic or server ISO, written with Fedora Media Writer or dd. A 4 GB stick is enough for the live images. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk.

editions.name: Workstation
editions.description: The GNOME desktop Fedora is known for, live and installable from the same ISO.
editions.usbNote: 4 GB stick or larger. Fedora Media Writer writes the live image; dd works too, and writing erases the stick.

editions.name: KDE Plasma Desktop
editions.description: The official KDE edition: Plasma instead of GNOME, live and installable from the same ISO.
editions.usbNote: 4 GB stick or larger; the live image boots plasma and installs from the same menu.

editions.name: Silverblue
editions.description: The atomic GNOME desktop: the system is an image that updates in place, with container-focused workflows.
editions.usbNote: 4 GB stick or larger. The ostree installer offers fewer choices than the Workstation one.

editions.name: Server
editions.description: The Server DVD: a standard installer with the packages for a server install, no network needed.
editions.usbNote: The DVD image is larger than the live ones; use a stick that fits it. Writing erases the stick.

editions.name: Cinnamon
editions.description: Cinnamon spin of Fedora 44, with that desktop's package set on the live image.
editions.usbNote: 2.6 GB image. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.

editions.name: Xfce
editions.description: Xfce spin of Fedora 44, with that desktop's package set on the live image.
editions.usbNote: 2.3 GB image. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.

editions.name: Budgie
editions.description: Budgie spin of Fedora 44, with that desktop's package set on the live image.
editions.usbNote: 2.5 GB image. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.
